evidence.quote:
proc sql; create table a02 as
select a.permno, a.fyear, a.RDQ, floor(a.SICCD/100) as industry, (d.permno~=. & d.TS=.) as Treat, (a.fyear>1934) as Post, a.TS~=. as sale_nm,
	(a.ib-b.ib)/(0.5*(a.TA+b.TA)) as dE, a.ib/(0.5*(a.TA+b.TA)) as e, b.ib/(0.5*(b.TA+c.TA)) as e_lag1, (b.ib-c.ib)/(0.5*(b.TA+c.TA)) as de_lag1, 
	(a.ib-b.ib)>0 as GoodNews, a.MA_BA as MtB,
	a.fyear-h.min_fyear as age, a.SHROUT/b.SHROUT>1.05 as Issue, a.TD/a.TA as Leverage, log(a.TA) as Size, a.COMDIV ~in(.,0) as Dividend, g.MKTSHR, 
	i.INCCONF__Indicator_ as INCCONF, i.CONTCONF__Indicator_ as CONTCONF, i.Delaware__Indicator_ as Delaware,
	floor(a.SICCD/10) in(371,372,481,482,489,363,366,369,781,783,791,351-357,381,383,384,387,491,493) as Tech, 
	floor(a.SICCD/10) in(481,482,489,460,419,422,440,450,474,471,491,493,492,499) as Regulated,
	max(Big_9_Auditor__Indicator_*2,Small_Auditor__Indicator_,No_Auditor__Indicator_-1) as AUDITOR,
	Intangible_Assets__Indicator_ as CONSERV,
	(a.TS~=.)+(Cost_of_Sales_Cost_of_Goods_Sold~=".")+(a.DEPRECIA~=.)+(a.TAXES~=.)+Other_Operating_Expenses__Indica as ISTRANSP,
	(Net_PPE__USD_~=".")+(Intangible_Assets__Indicator_)+(VAR14~=".")+(Reserves_other_than_Depreciation)+(a.RETEARN~=.) as BSTRANSP,
	j.Headquarter, k.*,
	log(a.TA) as Size_lag1, a.COMDIV ~in(.,0) as Dividend_lag1, coalesce(b.COMDIV,0)/(0.5*(b.TA+c.TA)) as Dividend_Yield_lag1, b.ib<0 as Loss_lag1, ((b.CSTK+b.RETEARN+b.TD-b.CASH)-(c.CSTK+c.RETEARN+c.TD-c.CASH))/(0.5*(b.TA+c.TA)) as AC_lag1
from a01 a 
left join a01 b on a.permno=b.permno & a.fyear=b.fyear+1
left join a01 c on a.permno=c.permno & a.fyear=c.fyear+2
left join a01(where=(fyear=1932)) d on a.permno=d.permno
left join (select permno, fyear, floor(SICCD/100) as industry, TA/sum(TA) as MKTSHR 
		   from a01 group by industry, fyear) g on a.permno=g.permno & a.fyear=g.fyear
left join (select permno, min(fyear) as min_fyear from a01 group by permno) h on a.permno=h.permno
left join waymire i on a.permno=i.permno & a.fyear=i.fyear
left join Incorp_state j on a.permno=j.permno
left join sec_enforce k on k.state=j.Headquarter
having a.permno+a.fyear+de+RDQ~=.;quit;
evidence.description: A02 joins current/prior annual A01 records, the 1932 treatment record, Waymire, incorporation state and SEC enforcement and derives the panel variables.

proc sql; create table r05 as
select a.*, (b._RSQ_/(1-b._RSQ_)) as ret_sync, c.CVEARN, d.Prin1 as Quality
from a05 a
